body.p: Plugins or frameworks installed in can contain folders named .agents, .ai-positron or ai-positron from where custom AI actions are automatically loaded from by the AI Positron.

When working in an Oxygen Content Fusion project, AI Positron also loads custom actions from any of the folders .agents, .ai-positron or ai-positron located in the project root. If either of these folders also contains an AGENTS.md or ai-context.md file, its contents are automatically loaded as the project context prompt for new chats. A project context prompt is also loaded from an AGENTS.md file placed in the project root folder. Updates to the actions or context file are applied when you start a new chat.

When Content Fusion (with the AI Positron plugin installed) is connected to a Git project that contains a folder in the project root named .agents, or .ai-positron, or ai-positron, AI actions defined in any of those folders are automatically loaded by the AI Positron plugin and used to present custom AI actions and actions defined in excluded-action-ids.txt files are filtered out.
